test_case_name: Open search bar and perform a search on Exclusive landing page (desktop) after navigating from main menu

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' in the main menu
Click 'Search' to open the search bar (desktop)
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search input
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search (desktop)
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Open login panel and attempt guest login on Exclusive landing page (desktop) after navigating from main menu

intents.intent: Click 'Exclusive' in the main menu
Click 'Accesso clienti' to open the login panel (desktop)

Type $password into the 'Password' input
Click 'ENTRA' to submit the guest login form
And then check that the user is logged in or receives an appropriate error message
